title: What makes the nest?
hook: Some wasps make a nest from gathered material.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The first scene shows a wasp gathering plant fibers; the second shows the fibers forming paper-like nest cells. Paper-wasp nest construction varies by species, and this drawing is not a record of an observed nest.

misconception: Every insect nest is made of spider silk.
objective: In this schematic paper-wasp example, what material forms the nest walls?

claims.text: Some wasps make a nest from gathered material. In this schematic paper-wasp example, what material forms the nest walls?
